item.title: The hard climb for Charlotte Rose
item.description: Following her Olympic Trials defeat, ILCA 6 hopeful Charlotte Rose goes all in once again, this time for LA 2028. Story by Alison Chenard for Sailing World: She won the most races of any ILCA 6 competitor at the 2024 U.S. Olympic Trials. She’s only 25 years old, but with two back-to-back Youth World Champion titles to her name, she’s a respected force in one of the most competitive sailing classes in the world. item.title: That was then, This is now
item.description: Light and variable winds are shaping as a key feature of this year’s Rolex Sydney Hobart Yacht Race, with early forecasts pointing to a tactical opening phase rather than a flat-out drag race along the 628-nautical course. The 80th edition begins December 26, and it's looking to be a navigators race.
